Pretupid Client 0.1.3 makes your cosmetics look and feel better, and keeps them in sync for everyone around you. Get the launcher for your system below; it installs and updates the client for you. Playing with another launcher? Drop the client jar into your `mods` folder next to Fabric API.

## What's new

### Client
- **Pets that follow you:** pets now float beside you, trail behind when you move and turn smoothly, instead of sticking to your head.
- **Cape physics:** capes bend and sway as you walk and settle when you stop. It is on by default and can be turned off in the Capes tab.
- **Minecraft capes:** equip any cape from your Microsoft account right from the Capes tab, next to the Pretupid capes.
- **New Pretupid cape:** the official cape now uses the current Pretupid design.
- **Emotes on the move:** emotes keep playing while you walk and stop when you sneak. Choose what stops an emote in *Cosmetics → Emotes*.
- **HUD editor:** open it with H (rebindable), the toolbar sits at the bottom by default, and the hint text is gone.
- **Sharper logo:** the Pretupid button in the main and pause menu is no longer pixelated.
- **Steady nametags:** name motion no longer stretches the nametag background. Turn *Background follows motion* on if you liked it.
- **Faster sync:** name style, cosmetics and emotes reach other Pretupid players right away, and new official capes, trails and emotes show up without restarting.

### Launcher
- The launcher stays at version 0.1.2. Fresh downloads include a **Minecraft Capes** picker on the Skins page; installed launchers get it with the next launcher update.

### Website
- Downloads always point to the newest launcher and client, even when they are released separately.

## Downloads
- **Windows:** `Pretupid.Launcher_0.1.2_x64-setup.exe`
- **macOS:** `Pretupid.Launcher_0.1.2_aarch64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) or `Pretupid.Launcher_0.1.2_x64.dmg` (Intel)
- **Linux:** `.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm`
- **Client mod:** `pretupid-client-0.1.3+mc26.3.jar`
- **Source:** the source code archives below

The launcher updates Pretupid Client to 0.1.3 on its own, and the client offers the update in-game as well.
